system_thesis_interpretation: The proposal preserves the project thesis only in a narrow component sense. THINK supplies a frozen child's own strict final actions after visible condition and public binary-outcome experience; DREAM verifies that provenance but deliberately removes the initial action and outcome, rendering only tool, mode, a neutral endpoint frame, and the exact child-authored final ACT; SLEEP is represented by four isolated target-masked LoRA fits. This is a clean assay of whether that fixed writer can store a structured collection of supervised visible-state-to-action associations without the broad action propensity seen in Cell F and R5. It is not an assay of autonomous credit assignment or of the causal value of the outcome, because correctness selection makes the final action answer-bearing and the outcome is absent from training. Nor does it test reasoning-path learning, unseen-key generalization, retention after later writes, writer qualification, parenting, child development, C11, or the complete organism. No current scientific evidence or authority follows from the proposal or this interpretation.
graph_delta_interpretation: Each root contains eight selected tools crossed with two visible modes, with four tools in each of two opposite orientation strata. M+ and M- complement all sixteen tool-by-mode targets while remaining matched on target marginals and declared training geometry. This is substantially more diagnostic than one binary opposition: an adapter must use tool identity as well as mode, and the complementary adapter is a strong wrong-map control. The actual mapping family nevertheless has eight independent tool-orientation bits, not sixteen arbitrary independent key labels, because the two modes of a tool are deterministically complementary. A pass therefore supports carriage of the declared structured sixteen-key policy, not unrestricted sixteen-association capacity. Pair eligibility across both mirror worlds and lowest-ID selection give the two adapters identical, result-blind case geometry and preserve child authorship, but they also condition on cases and tools the base child could solve in both worlds; the pass is explicitly conditional on that selected easy/stable endpoint population. Once selected, the target bytes are scientifically equivalent to correct labels for the fixed map, so child authorship is provenance, not a manipulated cause. The full-map oracle checks that held prompts and the action interface make the conditional task executable. OFF, complementary adapters, per-stratum reads, first-authoritative-action scoring, four separate spill families, and absolute action-interface checks collectively address the historical broad-habit confound better than the retired v1 design. They do not establish general non-harm or absence of spill outside those four fixed families.
loop_delta_interpretation: The future loop first freezes maps, identifiers, source/report surfaces, seeds, parsers, reducers, thresholds, and workload bytes. It then obtains two-world source trajectories for all candidates, selects the lowest two pair-eligible cases per key and lowest four eligible tools per stratum without replacement, compiles 128 target-masked items per adapter, and fits R0/W+, R0/W-, R1/W+, and R1/W- from the same frozen base revision. Within a root the two fits are deliberately paired on every declared nuisance dimension; across roots, opaque identities, cases, surfaces, and seeds are disjoint, although the base model, algorithms, grammar, thresholds, and recipe remain shared. Thus the roots are independent operational replications of the frozen assay, not independent model families or a population sample. Every root must pass without pooling, recipe changes, dose escalation, root replacement, or efficacy retry. The scientific read combines unseen-rendering generation, held-form likelihood, explicit-map feasibility, spill, and multi-turn interface behavior. The proposed three-A40-hour stop makes GPU use potentially high-value because the same four-fit budget that v1 spent partly on a result-blind D0 is redirected to two central roots; however the packet does not yet enumerate a complete inference and teacher-forced workload or generated-token cap for all source and read stages, so the resource ceiling is not reproducibly auditable as written. The first-fit projection also occurs only after the large source phase and one central fit have already consumed resources. Model, tokenizer, source-generation, fitting, and GPU execution remain outside the current requested scope and require a later immutable manifest, reviews, and exact human ratification.
claim_delta_interpretation: A full two-root pass would be positive evidence for one narrow necessary capability: four development adapters trained on correctness-selected child-authored endpoint actions produced map-specific single-action behavior for the same sixteen seen tool-by-mode keys under held renderings, while satisfying the four frozen spill families. The defensible wording must retain 'correctness-selected,' 'seen keys,' 'structured/counterbalanced policy,' 'two development roots,' and 'no detected spill on the four bound families.' It must not become a claim of autonomous experiential learning, causal use of outcome, arbitrary sixteen-key capacity, unseen-tool generalization, general interface safety, general non-harm, retention, qualified writing, or organism-level benefit. The generated gates are aggregate and stratum-level, while the directional teacher-forced requirement permits four of sixteen keys to miss its threshold; consequently 'across sixteen keys' describes the assayed policy support, not demonstrated threshold-level success on every key. The key bootstrap is descriptive for this fixed panel unless its dependence structure is repaired. Two disjoint roots reduce sensitivity to a single source/render/seed realization but do not support broad population inference because both share one pretrained model and one assay construction. The retired v1 remains NOT_RUN and contributes no result. A pass can justify proposing, not automatically running, a separately deliberated cumulative-interference or retention scout; all claims still require their own gate and human authority.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The intended firewall is scientifically appropriate: the child sees tool, mode, unordered legal actions, its initial action, and only a public binary outcome during source generation; hidden mapping, correctness, admission, cases, and report surfaces never reach it. DREAM may verify lived provenance but may render only tool, mode, neutral frame, and one exact final child ACT. Training sees the compiled context and sole target but not the initial action, outcome, mapping, admission, provenance IDs, or held surfaces. Evaluation opens held surfaces only after adapter commitment and uses the sealed mapping only in the reducer; no stored final action or lived history appears in evaluation prompts. This removes the repeat-after-success/flip-after-failure shortcut from the writer input. It does not remove answer supervision: the correctness-selected final ACT is intentionally the complete label. The four-stage matrix is role-coarse at source, because its 'hidden_mapping_and_eligibility/source = hidden' cell simultaneously says the harness applies the mapping; later implementation must distinguish harness/evaluator visibility from child/model visibility so 'hidden' cannot be interpreted as inaccessible to the outcome and admission machinery. Held-surface disjointness must also be mechanical and frozen, not merely a human judgment that two phrasings differ. Mutation tests should cover semantic ingress through hashes, counts, ordering, error behavior, and selection decisions as well as literal forbidden fields.
acceptance_test_interpretation: MWG2_T01 must prove exact two-root identity disjointness, twenty-four-candidate and eight-selected-tool geometry, four-per-stratum selection, complementary balanced maps, 32 retained endpoints per world, 128 items per adapter, and every source/read/teacher-forced/call/token upper bound; as written, exact_scope.md lacks enough totals and generated-token caps to close the final workload portion. MWG2_T02 must fail every literal and semantic forbidden ingress, exact-target-copy violation, evaluator-authored or repaired target, mask/EOS error, held-surface leak, and initial-action/outcome shortcut. MWG2_T03 must prove pair eligibility jointly across mirrored worlds, deterministic lowest-ID case and tool selection, complete publication of failures, and no top-up, redraw, replacement, or post-outcome adaptation. MWG2_T04 must establish within-root equality of targets, contexts and target length vectors, supervised positions, order, steps, seeds, node, and update geometry before fitting; this controls mirror nuisance differences but does not make roots independent of the shared model or recipe. MWG2_T05 correctly makes only the first authoritative ACT score and makes extra, invalid, DONE-first, post-DONE, over-budget, or long-continuation behavior incapable of improving the result. MWG2_T06 must exercise every equality boundary, per-root no-pooling rule, q/I/tau/g/NLL/oracle/validity/spill gate, and all labels; it cannot have a unique expected result until the current precedence conflict between INTERFACE_OR_FLOOD_INVALID and BINDING_WITH_SPILL is resolved. It should also test clustering or avoid inferential language for the sixteen-key bootstrap. MWG2_T07 must prove fail-if-exists, realpath and symlink safety, immutable lifecycle, exact retry class, preserved failures, and zero read/write/import contact with child, parent, PCFL, CompilerGym, C11, or other forbidden roots. MWG2_T08 is a readiness gate, not evidence: one genuinely fresh independent reviewer and a separate author-side advocate must inspect identical immutable manifest and receipts; the advocate cannot override a rejection, and their PASS results only permit Rohin to consider a separate exact execution ratification. Collectively these are necessary preconditions for bounded execution, not proof that the scientific claim is true.
assumptions: The two roots are disjoint assay realizations but share one pretrained base, one protocol, and one writer recipe; 'independent' does not mean independent model samples or population-level experimental units.

The sixteen keys are repeated observations nested within eight tools, with the two mode targets for a tool constrained to be complements; prompt forms and decoding replicates are repeated measurements rather than independent units.

The frozen source child, OFF evaluator, and adapter base use the exact same locally cached model and tokenizer revision unless a later manifest explicitly and prospectively states a narrower justified distinction.

Pair eligibility and deterministic lowest-ID selection are performed only by the sealed harness after source completion, and neither admission nor mapping affects model-visible bytes, retries, or source decoding.

A successful target is copied byte-exactly from the child's strict final ACT and is never normalized, repaired, substituted, or authored by the evaluator beyond a separately validated canonical action parser.

Action probabilities and NLLs use a single prospectively bound sequence-likelihood convention for possibly multi-token action strings, with identical chat prefixes, EOS treatment, and normalization in OFF, W+, and W-.

The thresholds and all source, training, oracle, primary, spill, teacher-forced, and interface surfaces are immutable before the first source output, and infrastructure retry cannot change any semantic input or RNG stream.

A clean two-root pass is only evidence about the fixed selected tools, modes, mappings, surfaces, model, dose, and spill panel; it is not automatic scientific-claim, promotion, or execution authority.

ambiguities.question: What exact sequence-probability, token-length normalization, EOS convention, and zero-legal-mass rule define q, target NLL, and teacher-forced TV over a0/a1, and is legal-ACT emission 'change' signed, absolute, or only an increase?
ambiguities.impact: Opaque actions can tokenize differently, and a normalized two-action TV can miss a large fall in total legal-action mass; without one exact rule, optimization and spill labels can change at the threshold.

ambiguities.question: Exactly which adapters, maps, prompt families, forms, and replicate reductions constitute strict one-ACT validity overall and by stratum, and how are empty, invalid, multiple-ACT, and generation-error trials represented in every denominator?
ambiguities.impact: The 0.95 and 0.875 gates are not reproducible until their observation set and aggregation order are explicit; changing that denominator could turn flooding into a pass or a negative result.

ambiguities.question: What mechanical rule makes source, training, primary, teacher-forced, oracle, spill, and interface surfaces disjoint, and what exact token-level relation qualifies a control tool as a near-neighbour rather than merely a different token sequence?
ambiguities.impact: Loose template disjointness can reduce 'unseen rendering' to the same decisive scaffold, while an undefined near-neighbour weakens the most local spill probe.

ambiguities.question: Which concrete source-phase components may semantically read the hidden mapping, outcome rule, correctness, and eligibility, given that the visibility cell labels them hidden at source while its reason says the harness applies them?
ambiguities.impact: A stage-level label that conflates child and harness can either make source execution impossible or permit answer/admission leakage unless the later role-specific contract is exact.

ambiguities.question: Are initial and final actions produced in one model session per trajectory, what are their exact decoding/token limits and parser rules, and can invalid initial or final actions ever be retried within a case?
ambiguities.impact: These details determine the true source workload, selection mechanism, pair-eligibility rate, and whether ostensibly immutable cases hide adaptive retries.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The frozen decision precedence is internally inconsistent: step 4 assigns INTERFACE_OR_FLOOD_INVALID for any spill-family or flood failure before step 5 can assign BINDING_WITH_SPILL when non-spill binding passes but spill or flood fails.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Every result eligible for BINDING_WITH_SPILL is already consumed by the earlier condition, so the label is unreachable and MWG2_T06 cannot return a unique predeclared label for those tables.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Before ratification, rewrite the precedence and predicates so interface invalidity, action flooding, and spill-only failures have mutually exclusive reachable labels; then bind exhaustive single-failure and combined-failure truth tables.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The claim text can be read as successful carriage on all sixteen keys even though the directional teacher-forced gate requires threshold success on only twelve of sixteen keys and generated behavior has no all-key minimum.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Aggregate balanced accuracy and per-stratum floors can coexist with stable failures on a subset of keys. Saying the adapters 'carried ... across sixteen keys' without this qualifier overstates the per-key evidence.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Either add a prospectively justified all-key generated and teacher-forced floor, or retain the current gates and revise the permitted claim to say the structured sixteen-key policy passed aggregate/stratum gates with at least twelve keys passing the directional likelihood threshold.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: A paired bootstrap over sixteen keys treats the two modes of each tool as independent even though their targets are deterministically complementary and they share tool identity, endpoints, adapter parameters, and orientation assignment.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: This can make the lower confidence bound anti-conservative and gives inferential weight to a sample size larger than the eight independently assigned tool identities. Four surface forms and two generation replicates are also repeated measurements.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Bootstrap the eight tool clusters, preserving both modes and all within-tool observations, or label the key bootstrap as a fixed-panel descriptive stability calculation and remove confidence-language implications. Root-wise results must remain separate.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: The proposal claims a three-A40-hour workload stop and asks MWG2_T01 to verify every upper bound, but exact_scope.md does not enumerate a complete end-to-end source, oracle, spill, teacher-forced, interface-turn, or generated-token workload.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: Two roots alone imply 1,536 candidate source trajectories before selection, in addition to four fits and the bound reads; without exact per-emission caps, sequence counts, throughput priors, and a projection formula, the resource ceiling and value-of-information comparison are not independently reproducible. The first-fit estimate also arrives after source generation and one central fit.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Add an exact workload ledger before approval: enumerate all source turns/calls, generation calls and turns, teacher-forced sequence evaluations, per-call and per-turn token maxima, retry accounting, prior throughput receipts, projection formula, and whether already-spent source time is included in the three-hour cap. Require result-blind stopping against that bound.

disagreements_with_proposal.statement: Calling R0 and R1 'independent roots' is acceptable operational shorthand but is too strong if read as independent scientific draws.
disagreements_with_proposal.rationale: They share the same base model, action grammar, compiler and evaluator algorithms, thresholds, optimizer recipe, and structured mapping family; systematic model or prompt-family failures can recur in both roots.
disagreements_with_proposal.proposed_resolution: Define independence as disjoint opaque identities, source cases, surfaces, and RNG streams under one frozen shared assay, and keep all claims conditional on that shared model and construction.
